notes:
## New features
- The project Save button briefly confirms a successful save.
- Global Settings has dedicated sidebar navigation with clearer, more compact sections.

## Changes
- Basemap alignment now uses the shared AURIS method switcher, compact method-specific controls and larger previews. Online map search/source and terrain/import actions each share a single muted toolbar.
- Full-bleed logos now default to Cover; existing saved image-fit choices are retained.
- Project descriptions grow with the panel height, wrap without a horizontal scrollbar, and no longer need a resize grip.
- Project and contour fields use consistent medium-weight text.
- Level bands form one continuous list, including below-range and above-range colours, with no nested scrollbar or hard table borders.
- Sheet preview and Editor use the shared AURIS switcher, with aligned switcher heights, crisp zoom controls, explicit 100% scale and labelled map overlays.
- A quiet Local / OSGB36 indicator in the status bar replaces coordinate labels on the editor canvas; exported neatline styling is unchanged.
- Reduced regular-grid terrain-profile sampling overhead while retaining the same sampled elevations. Dense building scenes can still take several minutes because exact screening and building-edge support checks remain enabled.

## Bug fixes
- Consultant choices are restricted to the selected organisation, including its qualifications and sole-consultant default.
- Changing a contour minimum keeps the colours; changing the band count retains the original colour progression during editing.
- Improved narrow-panel control spacing and moved save/warning status badges closer to the window edge while keeping update progress centred.
- Terrain import batches now respect Google’s encoded URL limit as well as its 512-location limit, preserving precise OSGB36 coordinates. HTTP failures show the API reason without exposing the key.
- Basemap file selection now uses an owned, asynchronous file picker, with reliable cancel/reopen handling.
